subject.title: [Feature]: Cost metadata support for auto-discovered Amazon Bedrock models

question: Should user-supplied costs for discovered models be a Bedrock plugin-local `plugins.entries.amazon-bedrock.config.discovery.costs` map, or a generic model-pricing overlay that can patch any discovered provider/model ref?
rationale: Both shapes are technically plausible, but the repository has a high bar for new config surfaces and provider-owned behavior, so automation should not choose the public config contract by itself.

options.title: Prefer Generic Pricing Overlay
options.body: Add one generic model-cost overlay keyed by provider/model ref, then have Bedrock discovery consume the same resolved pricing path as future discovered providers.

options.title: Keep It Bedrock-Local
options.body: Add `plugins.entries.amazon-bedrock.config.discovery.costs` only, keeping the ownership local to the Bedrock plugin but accepting a provider-specific config shape.

options.title: Do Not Add Overlay
options.body: Keep the current explicit `models.providers.*.models[].cost` contract and document the redundancy as the supported workaround.

recommendation.title: Prefer Generic Pricing Overlay
recommendation.body: Add one generic model-cost overlay keyed by provider/model ref, then have Bedrock discovery consume the same resolved pricing path as future discovered providers.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is about provider discovery config shape, and Peter authored the current plugin-owned discovery config refactor.
